summary.text: Laurie Osher is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 25 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Osher has served in the Maine House since 2020 and has worked as a soil and watershed scientist and owns Osher Environment Systems.

paragraphs.text: Laurie Osher was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and lives in Orono, Maine.
She earned a B.S. from Cornell University in 1982, an M.S. in soils and geomorphology from North Carolina State University in 1985, and a Ph.D. from the University of California at Berkeley in 1997.
Her career experience includes working as a soil and watershed scientist with the USDA Forest Service and owning Osher Environment Systems.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey she said she was on the Orono Town Council from 2017 and was a University of Maine research and teaching faculty member from 1999 to 2008.
Osher was elected to Maine House District 123 in 2020 and won District 25 in 2022, succeeding Patrick Corey, and again in 2024.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee.
Republican Anthony Weaver is her 2026 general election opponent.
